name: @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset
description: DSH agent preset for the tavern-cards workflow: the stage machine, project tooling, tavern skills, four delegation tools, and their internal child presets composed into one declared preset
//dependencies-note: The @ai4rpg runtime dependencies are versioned ranges from npm. @ai4rpg/tavern-agents is a devDependency only: the generator reads its sibling checkout to embed the four personas into cordis.patch.yml, and the installed profile does not use it at runtime. In-repo dev installs of the plugin may use a --no-save directory install of a local tavern-stages checkout. @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-stages carries the stage config (tavernCardsStageConfig) and the persona loader (loadTavernAgents) the generator uses; @ai4rpg/dsh-stage-switch is the stage machine its stage-switch row mounts (declared explicitly because that row is ours, not a transitive detail); @ai4rpg/dsh-ui-sidebar-stage backs the host-plane sidebar tab row the generated patch carries. The @deepseek-ai/* entries are the upstream DSH packages the composed rows need at test time plus the official base composition (@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml) the generator derives from.
